name: glass-player
title: Glass Player
description: An audio player with cover art, seeking, repeat and mute.
useCases: On a lesson page, a student scrubs back to a phrase they missed in an audio explanation.
In a music catalog, a buyer loops a track preview to compare its arrangement with another version.
task: An audio player with cover art, seeking, repeat and mute.
behavior: Set src to a browser-accessible audio file and cover to an image. Replace /audio/intro.mp3 in the example with your recording.
